entity: US for-profit nursing homes whose operating company formed 2022 to Sept 2024 (a stand-in for a sale): star ratings vs same-state for-profit peers
what_we_add: 944 homes; 0.28 stars below same-state for-profit peers; 52% one- or two-star, 8 points above peers; median home 0.42 stars below
why:
ASPE and Skilled Nursing News say homes that change owners rate lower; JAGS and Penn LDI find a ~0.1-star dip after a sale. Same direction, but on CMS ownership-change records in earlier years.
No source names this 2022-2024 new-operator cohort or a same-state peer gap; a looser read would call it Matched.
